claim_ceiling: This stable package starts from the migration-selected Artifact Type contract, applies any recorded owner-review refinement, and binds its semantic dependencies to admitted Definitions. It does not admit the Artifact Type, admit any instance, authenticate fixture claims, integrate a consumer, or activate behavior.
distinct_validation_purpose: Records one immutable attributable execution of an exact Research Inquiry version, including digest-bearing inspected sources, performed method and deviations, observations, counterevidence, evidence-set result, limitations, timing, completion or stop state, ownership, and challenge route.

four_facets.classification: Candidate Research Run with explicit source bindings.
four_facets.human_continuation: Generated RECORD.md and the materialization review record explain the exact execution inputs, method, outputs, state, refinement, and limits.
four_facets.machine_checkable: Schema, typed reference closure and target-specific graph consistency checks.

name: Research Run

orthogonality_rules.statement: Candidate identity and exact graph references do not authenticate owners or execute effects.
Records immutable execution of a Research Inquiry and Method.
The exact Inquiry version and every inspected source digest are explicit; planned inputs or directory placement cannot substitute for observed execution inputs.
A completed or stopped execution and its evidence set do not become a Finding, decision, Definition, proof, admission, or Product claim.
Completed runs require observations, an evidence set, and an end time; stopped or failed runs require a stop reason and end time.

typed_residue.consequence: The package remains candidate-only and is absent from admitted Artifact Type authority.
typed_residue.missing: Artifact Type owner admission for this exact materialized package.

typed_residue.consequence: No operational or domain claim may be inferred from the candidate fixture.
typed_residue.missing: A real instance, bounded consumer integration, and an activation decision.
